svg.title: The same two lines, three winners
svg.text: The same setting twice. Which one wins is the software's rule, not a convention.
one rule carried to all three names the wrong line with confidence;
a change made to that line applies cleanly and alters nothing
includes follow the same rule: OpenSSH reads a drop-in where the Include stands (at the top it beats the main file, at the bottom it loses);
PostgreSQL likewise, the other way round; nginx inlines the file where the include stands, and a file its pattern does not match is not read at all
